# v0.1.18 preview

This artifact is a preview. It is not a claim of GitHub Actions
equivalence.

The version string is 0.1.18. The capability version is 12.

A `rookrunner/trust` error left by a stale merge ref now clears. When
a later pass finds the merge ref matching the same pull request head,
the error becomes a success. A head that already ran clears it too.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They
are not published. This change does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

The App private key is not in the artifact.
